_comment: Real machine and catalogue tools; cutting data are STARTING VALUES for 6061/6082 aluminium, not proven production parameters. Sources read 2026-11-08. Inventory, not a simultaneously loaded carousel. See README for assembly and policy assumptions.

machine.note: Read 2026-11-08. Main haascnc.com VF-2 fetch returned no spec table; Haas Automation UK full specification and archived Haas sheet agree. Standard 8100 rpm configuration; model-year/options may differ.

vise.note: Kurt 2022 US catalogue p18, DX6 manual: B jaw width 6.000 in, H jaw height 1.735 in, AA maximum opening 9.080 in. Maker PDF indexed text read 2026-11-08; direct download returned 403. Inches converted exactly by 25.4.

holder.note: IMTE IMT100314 CAT40-ER32-3.0: gauge L 3 in =76.2 mm, D 50 mm, range .079-.787 in (nominal 2-20 mm). Maker HTML table downloaded 2026-11-08. holder_length models gauge projection; holder_diameter uses nut envelope. Correct collet and CAT40 pull stud must be fitted.

end_mills.note: Guhring GA200 A 3309, bright two-flute HA shank, catalogue p155. p297 slotting aluminium wrought <=3% Si (includes AlMgSi1/6082): Vc300 m/min and fz at D3/6/10/12/16/20 =.015/.030/.055/.066/.090/.110. Apply maker bright-tool factors Vc x.6, fz x.75. Feed uses actual TWO flutes. Nominal flat end; catalogue .03/.05/.10 mm corner chamfer is not represented by resources end_mill.

drills.note: Guhring 206 DIN338 jobber bright HSS, 118 degree, shank=cut diameter; l1 overall, l2 flute (not tmax). Al wrought <200 BHN:260 SFM; IPR .0020/.0065/.0100/.0125 at chart diameters 1.590/3.170/6.350/9.520 mm. Use next smaller chart diameter (conservative, no extrapolation), convert IPR x25.4. Starting data for 6061/6082; catalogue marks aluminium optimal. The shared 205/206 chart has NO wrought-aluminium recommendation for205: use the206 row only.

spot.note: Guhring 723 carbide uncoated 90 degree NC spot, EDP9007230100000: D10, OAL89, flute25, shank10. Al wrought <200 BHN:575 SFM (uncoated723;755 belongs to coated6027), use lower chart D9.520 feed .0125 IPR x25.4. Only spotting, not full-depth drilling.

chamfer.note: TOYO uncoated TCM90-12:90 degree, shank/major D12, tip2.5, axial effective blade K4.75, seven flutes, OAL70. Aluminium Vc85-175 m/min, fz .015-.055 mm/tooth; use lower ends85 and .015. No D16 in this published family.

threads.note: Harvey 2026 catalogue p552, 8821xx single-form metric, uncoated. Individual -C3 product pages verify same geometry/axial LOC (links per tool). SF_882100 5x-neck chart: wrought 6xxx1000 SFM; use next smaller diameter column IPT, convert x25.4; four flutes. Use only listed coarse pitch per size (min=max); no unverified multi-pitch range. tooth_height is axial LOC, not radial tooth depth. neck_length conservatively uses full published max thread depth. Chart step3: internal feed correction (major diameter - cutter diameter)/major diameter is applied at the named nominal thread size; larger threads at the same pitch retain this conservative centerline feed.

_policy: All RPM=min(8100,floor(1000*Vc/(pi*D))); imperial Vc=SFM*.3048. Feed=RPM*fz*flutes or RPM*feed/rev, rounded .01 mm/min. All feeds preserve chart chip load at capped RPM. Plunge is shop starting policy 25% of lateral feed for end/thread/chamfer mills; stepdown=.5D and stepover=.4D for end mills, within maker general roughing engagement table. Stickout is a chosen assembly, not maker geometry: flute+5 mm for end mills, flute+5 for drills/spot, 15 mm for chamfer, max thread depth+5 for threads. Holders common to all, see holder source. No parallels dimensions are assumed; planner reports unmodelled supports.
_omitted: 6 mm ball end mill: no ball end type in resources/camlib adapter.
16 mm chamfer mill: no 16 mm cutter in sourced TOYO family; no verified matching geometry/cutting-data pair.

machines._comment: Source _sources.machine for all machine figures: travel762x406x508 mm (30x16x20 in), spindle8100 rpm/30 hp=22.4 kW/40 taper, automatic20-pocket carousel, flood coolant. Changer full-pocket tool envelope3.5 in (89 mm), max tool weight12 lb (5.4 kg); these are NOT shank capacity. max_tool_diameter_mm=20 models ER32 shank capacity from _sources.holder. Dealer/model-year rates: rapid1000 ipm=25400 mm/min, max cutting650 ipm~16500 mm/min, agreeing Haas UK and archived sheet; not a promise for all years (some listings1400 ipm). NGC post: camlib examples/haas_ngc_post.py; metadata only pending stevecad/camlib#120. DX6 dimensions from _sources.vise.
